grammar.title: "I've never tried..." + Comparações
rules: "I've never tried/tasted/eaten + something" expressa uma experiência inédita usando present perfect: I've never tried such a spicy dish.
Comparativo com "-er/more + than" compara duas coisas: This dish is tastier than the other one.
"as + adjetivo + as" compara igualdade (negativa com "never...as...as"): I've never tasted anything as sweet as this.
"way better/much tastier" intensificam a comparação de forma informal e enfática.
